subject: use RCytoscape to put custom graphics on nodes

messages.author: a54722eec6bfa845
messages.subject: use RCytoscape to put custom graphics on nodes
parts:
I have added a 'recipe' to the RCytoscape website which explains,
first in overview, then in detail, how to render nodes in Cytoscape
from custom graphics image files.

Since data-driven graphics are easily created in R, and since RCy
makes it easy to place these images on nodes in Cytoscape, this
capability may be of interest to some.

The recipe (with working code) can be found at

http://rcytoscape.systemsbiology.net

Click on 'examples' then
'Informational' nodes: plots, legends

or browse straight to

http://rcytoscape.systemsbiology.net/versions/current/cookbook/infoNodes/index.html

Suggestions and critique are most welcome.

Cheers,

- Paul
